title: 4-axis style system + 3-style inline preview for the experimental renderer
depends_on: experimental-carousel-pipeline (must be deployed as baseline first)

decisions.schema_source: itchernetski/threads-carousel-claude-skill presets.ts (4-axis: font x surface x accent x background)
decisions.button_layout: 3 buttons in admin block, 2+1 rows (Dark+Teal, Paper+Orange, White+Coral)
decisions.callback_format: carousel_exp_render:<export_id>:<style_id>; 2-segment form falls back to dark_teal for back-compat
decisions.highlight_words: ExperimentalSlide.highlights new field; rendered as <span class='hl'> with style.accent_color
decisions.light_surface_external_bg: uses dark overlay rgba(7,10,18,0.62->0.76) to keep readability

out_of_scope: cleanup of accumulated experimental export packages
